business.name: Campbell's Collision Repair Shop
business.tagline: 5.0 stars. 36 reviews. Collision repair on W 25th St, Indianapolis.

hours.weekday: Mon to Fri, 8 AM to 5:30 PM

process.title: Estimate
process.body: Drive in or send photos. Written estimate within 24 hours, line by line, no surprises. We walk through every item with you before any wrench turns.

process.title: Insurance
process.body: We file the claim, handle the adjuster, manage the supplements. You drop off the vehicle and go about your week.

process.title: Repair
process.body: OEM parts where the repair calls for it. Text updates at every milestone. No scope changes without a phone call first.

process.title: Pickup
process.body: Washed, vacuumed, inspected. Finished photos in hand. Lifetime workmanship warranty in writing before you drive off.

services.title: Collision Repair
services.body: From fender bends to full structural damage. Frame straightening, panel replacement, and factory-spec alignment. Every job backed by a lifetime workmanship warranty.
services.ideal: Insurance claims, accident damage, fleet repairs

services.title: Auto Paint & Refinish
services.body: Computer-matched color in a downdraft spray booth. PPG basecoat and clearcoat system, blended through adjacent panels so the repair line disappears.
services.ideal: Faded paint, color restoration, full resprays

services.title: Frame Straightening
services.body: Computerized measuring against factory spec. Straightened, documented, and signed off with a before-and-after printout you keep.
services.ideal: Heavy collision, structural damage, unibody pulls

services.title: Dent & Bumper Repair
services.body: Paintless dent repair when the metal allows it. Full refinish when it does not. We tell you which one up front so there are no surprises on the invoice.
services.ideal: Hail damage, parking lot dings, bumper scuffs

services.title: Rust & Corrosion Repair
services.body: Indiana winters put road salt on every panel. We cut out rust, weld in new metal, seal, prime, and paint. The repair outlasts the original finish.
services.ideal: Wheel wells, rocker panels, undercarriage, salt damage

services.title: Auto Glass
services.body: Windshield and side glass replacement. We handle the insurance call so you coordinate with one shop, not two.
services.ideal: Cracked windshield, rock chips, side window replacement

faqs.q: Do you work directly with my insurance company?
faqs.a: Yes. We file the claim, coordinate with your adjuster, and bill the carrier directly. You drop off the vehicle and pick it up when it is ready. No phone tag, no paperwork on your end.

faqs.q: How long will my repair take?
faqs.a: Most standard collision repairs take 3 to 7 business days. Frame work or full repaints can run 10 to 14 days. We give you a written timeline in your estimate before any work starts, and we call if anything changes.

faqs.q: Can you fix rust and salt damage from Indiana winters?
faqs.a: Yes. Road salt corrosion on rocker panels, wheel wells, and undercarriages is one of our most common repairs. We cut out the rust, weld in new metal, seal, prime, and paint. The repair outlasts the original finish.

faqs.q: What does the lifetime warranty cover?
faqs.a: Every repair we complete is backed by a written lifetime workmanship warranty for as long as you own the vehicle. If anything we touched fails, we fix it at no charge.
When the repair calls for it, yes. We discuss parts options during the estimate. OEM, certified aftermarket, and recycled parts each have a place depending on the vehicle age and insurance coverage.

faqs.q: Can I get a repair without going through insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. We do out-of-pocket repairs at flat pricing. You know the total before we start. Many customers go that route for minor work like bumper scuffs or parking lot dings.

faqs.q: Do you help with rental car arrangements?
faqs.a: We coordinate with Enterprise and National for rental pickup while your vehicle is in the shop. If your policy covers a rental, we help set that up on the first day.
